name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: Either Geologist goes with 18 ly or Dasari goes with 14 ly.
Exactly two of these are true: Anders goes with Engineer; Cho goes with Botanist; Rios goes with Geologist.
Botanist, Engineer, and Geologist go with Anders, Rios, and 18 ly, in some order.
Between 10 ly and 14 ly, one goes with Dasari and the other with Engineer.
10 ly goes with Engineer if and only if either 12 ly goes with Medic or Botanist does not go with 18 ly (but not both).

hints.text: Suppose Anders went with Botanist — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Anders goes with Botanist.
Anders goes with Botanist, so it can't also go with Engineer.
Botanist goes with Anders, so Cho can't go with Botanist.
…but now the clue “Exactly two of these are true: Anders goes with Engineer; Cho goes with Botanist; Rios goes with Geologist” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Anders does not go with Botanist.

hints.text: Suppose Anders didn't go with Engineer — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Anders does not go with Engineer.
